requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop HP’s first business ink tank printer specifically tailored for micro and small businesses, supporting 5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, and AMPV of 500 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment and targets SMBs seeking ROI and efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer model released with ink tank technology; supports SMB scale and usage requirements.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions to simplify business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP from competitors and meets SMB needs for easy management and workflow efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features for print and scan workflow implemented and validated; manageability tools available for SMBs.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage their printers, targeting office managers and generalist IT staff.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT teams and need easy device management solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal released and accessible; supports device management for SMBs; validated by user testing.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan delivers HP’s lowest business TCO for SMBs, including cost-efficient hardware, supplies, and minimal intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Key purchase driver for SMBs looking for ROI and efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO benchmarks validated against competitors; documented in marketing materials.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Parts and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Design Magellan with customer replaceable parts (PHA) and maintenance box; serviceable at service centers if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and intervention for SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Parts are replaceable by customers; service center support available; validated by service documentation.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent errors and ensure correct usage.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes mistakes and enhances user experience for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are keyed; user testing confirms reduction in refill errors.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance and Support
requirements.Description: Offer PDL SKU with improved speed (25/20 min), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Targets higher-end SMBs needing performance and compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU released with specified speed and certifications; performance validated.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU Solutions and Portal Support
requirements.Description: Provide SMB2.0 solutions and Advanced View SMB portal for non-PDL SKUs; supports PaaS.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of SMBs with different requirements and supports HP’s PaaS goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU includes required solutions and portal; validated by solution documentation.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% RCP
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan achieves 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), surpassing competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability goals and provides a competitive advantage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material composition verified; sustainability claims validated; comparison with competitors documented.

requirements.Title: Minimal Maintenance Requirement
requirements.Description: Design Magellan for maintenance-free or reduced maintenance with fewer parts to replace over product life.
requirements.Rationale: Appeals to SMBs with limited IT resources and reduces operational costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance requirements documented; user testing confirms reduced maintenance needs.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing functionality through HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern office workflows and enhances user convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing tested and validated via HP App; user feedback collected.

requirements.Title: Warranty – 80k pages or 2 years
requirements.Description: Offer warranty coverage for 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever is first.
requirements.Rationale: Provides reassurance to SMBs and aligns with their usage patterns.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published; coverage validated in product documentation.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to monitor printer usage, health, and performance for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Supports proactive maintenance, analytics, and product improvement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features implemented and validated; data collection confirmed.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports Printing as a Service (PaaS) business models.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic goals and market evolution.
requirements.Dependencies: Non-PDL SKU Solutions and Portal Support
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features documented and validated; integration with HP PaaS platforms.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan Features
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven Perfect Print and Perfect Scan features for superior output and workflow efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates Magellan and provides tangible benefits to SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Perfect Print/Scan features implemented and validated; user feedback confirms value.
